summary.what_it_is: Claude-Mem gives AI coding agents persistent memory across sessions. It captures what the agent does, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context into future sessions.
summary.why_trending: The project gained over 5,000 stars in a week and shows a 'GitHub Trending Repository of the Day' badge in its README.
summary.who_its_for: Developers who use AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, or Copilot and want them to remember past work.
